name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PLR.rank_factor_eq_iff
title: If dY has full row rank, rank([X | E] dY) = rank X + m iff E has rank m and its column space meets that of X trivially
statement: Over a field K, let X be an S x kappa matrix, E an S x m matrix (S finite) and dY a (kappa + m) x U matrix of full row rank (rank dY = |kappa| + m). Then rank([X | E] dY) = rank X + m if and only if rank E = m and the column spaces of X and E intersect only in 0. This is the exact condition under which the rank factorization of the PLR-hop rank obstruction gives rank V' = m + rank{X_x}.
